questions.q: What are the four conditional paths available out of an activity?
options: Upon Success, Upon Failure, Upon Completion, and Upon Skip
Start, Running, Paused, and Stopped
Copy, Transform, Control, and Trigger
Retry, Timeout, Cancel, and Rerun
questions.explain: Every activity offers these four real conditional paths, letting you branch pipeline logic based on exactly how the previous activity finished.

questions.q: Which constraint applies to the Upon Completion path?
options: It can't coexist with Upon Success or Upon Failure on the same activity
It can only be used on the very first activity in a pipeline
It requires a Wait activity immediately after it
There is no constraint — all four paths can always be combined freely
questions.explain: You choose either the Upon Success/Upon Failure split, or the single Upon Completion path — not both on the same activity.

questions.q: In the Try-Catch-Proceed pattern, which paths feed into the activity that comes next?
options: The error handler's Upon Success path, and the first activity's Upon Skip path
Only the first activity's Upon Success path
Only the error handler's Upon Failure path
All four paths from the first activity, with no error handler involved
questions.explain: If the first activity succeeds, the error handler is skipped — and that skip itself satisfies the Upon Skip condition feeding the next activity, letting the pipeline proceed either way.

questions.q: Does adding an Upon Failure path automatically make the overall pipeline show "Failed" if that activity fails?
options: No — pipeline status is based on the leaf activities, not just whether any activity failed
Yes, always, with no exceptions
Only if the pipeline has fewer than five activities
Only if the failure path is left completely empty
questions.explain: Data Factory evaluates leaf activities to determine overall pipeline success — in a Try-Catch pattern, a successful error handler can make the pipeline show Success even though an earlier activity failed.

questions.q: If you want a failed activity to make the whole pipeline show "Failed" (for example, to trigger a downstream alert), which pattern should you use?
options: Do-If-Else, defining both Upon Failure and Upon Success paths
Try-Catch, defining only the Upon Failure path
Do-If-Skip-Else, with a dummy Upon Skip step
None of these patterns affect the overall pipeline status
questions.explain: Do-If-Else results in the pipeline showing Failure when the activity fails, since the Upon Success leaf is skipped and its parent node registers as failed.
